subject: Otyugh
picture: A dungeon scavenger monster. Body: one fat round body. Legs: three thick animal legs. Arms: two long rubbery tentacles coming from the shoulders, each ending in a flat spiked pad. Eyes: one tall stalk on top of the body with two eyes sitting together on that one stalk. Mouth: one wide horizontal mouth on the lower front of the body, empty. No plant, no branches, no leaves, no extra face. Refuse sacks and bones. Stone ceiling, walls, closed door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
